arc_rendering_rule: Backend arcs must be structurally legible; foreground prose must remain partial, delayed, fallible and under-explained. Longitudinal character transformation has priority over making an individual chapter thematically complete.
nonnegotiable_rules: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
No adaptation-only resume item becomes a historical credential unless separately promoted by an explicit canon decision.
High education raises selected cognitive baselines but does not imply universal negotiation, leadership, emotional or social skill.
Every strong capability must have a formation source, shadow cost and high-pressure failure mode.
Long educational and professional socialization attenuates but does not erase family-origin effects; family may reappear around money, care, hometown, authority and shame.
No secret or wound is announced as fact without scene evidence or explicit adaptation-only marking.
A virtue must be allowed to create costs; a flaw must be allowed to protect something real.
Local antagonists must have a legible interest, information set and value they are protecting.
Power changes how personality is expressed; scene analysis must separate trait from position effect.
Core six are weakly connected ensemble peers, not a permanent six-person team.
Prefer existing relationships; create a guest only for a real scene-function gap.
Every named guest needs a current goal, pressure, virtue-shadow pair, power position, bounded information set and 3-5 step micro arc.
Guest characters generated on demand must pass reverse plausibility audit before prose use.
Guest biography remains adaptation-only unless explicitly canonized later.
Narrative voice canon is provisional and controls distance, not character-specific syntax.
Campbell stages are backend structure only and must never become chapter labels, thesis dialogue or explicit self-diagnosis.
A stage may span several chapters or years; no chapter is required to resolve a stage.
Character transformation changes probabilities, thresholds and recovery patterns; it does not permanently remove old flaws.
Every core actor must retain at least one materially unresolved ambiguity at the 2035 observation horizon.
Readers may understand an arc before the character does; the narrator must not close that gap automatically.
Do not reward every mature decision immediately or fairly; environment and chance retain independent causal force.
Do not force romance, illness, family disaster, betrayal or redemption to complete an arc.
Do not use AI-summary endings, thesis dialogue, forced symbolism or universal self-awareness.
Ordinary time and non-events remain usable narrative material.
2035 is an observation endpoint, not a life verdict.
chapter_arc_audit: Which long-term hero stage does this chapter touch, if any?
Which stable trait or virtue-shadow pair is under pressure?
Did the prose explain the shadow more clearly than the character could actually know?
What changed: behavior, threshold, relationship, resource, interpretation, or nothing?
Did the chapter give an emotionally complete payoff only because the author wanted closure?
Could the final explanatory paragraph be deleted while the long arc remains legible?
Does this chapter leave enough uncertainty for later repetitions to change its meaning?

required_before_opening_order_lock: audit opening candidates against the six long hero arcs before prose drafting
draft the actual opening candidate chapter as disposable prose
compare opening energy, character legibility, world-entry burden and long-arc promise against the Luo pilot
revise the opening candidate once by subtraction
verify that the opening promises a long arc without explaining the arc
decide whether chapter 1 remains Zhou Ye or whether the novel should enter through a different scene
next_stage_gate.drafting_rule: Only one new full chapter at a time may advance to review. Every full chapter must pass both anti-AI subtraction review and long-arc/negative-space review before the next one begins.
